# Bastion — illustration v1

Image : [bastion-illustration-v1.png](bastion-illustration-v1.png).

Générée avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Interprétation visuelle proposée : géographie, architecture, armoiries, proportions et volumes d’eau représentés ne constituent pas de nouvelles décisions de canon. L’image a été inspectée ; elle montre la ville habitée, les fournaises, les conduites et les rideaux d’eau. Elle ne valide pas techniquement les circuits ni leurs capacités.

## Prompt de génération

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one large landscape illustration, a richly detailed painterly architectural fantasy concept art of LE BASTION, a inhabited medieval fortress-city in an original French fantasy world. No text, labels, border, logo or watermark. Elevated oblique three-quarter view close enough to read the actual infrastructure and small human crews; whole fortress dominates the composition, foreground gate and terraces lead into densely inhabited courtyards. Tragic grandeur, beautiful functional complexity, humane refuge, late blue dusk contrasted with orange furnace interiors and lit homes. Massive weathered pale stone walls, copper and ceramic conduits, slate roofs, buttresses, corner observation belvederes, four broad neighborhoods of workshops, gardens, market halls and homes around a modest central command court. The fortress appears alive through coordinated human activity and flowing resources, NOT a creature: no face, legs, flesh or organic monster architecture. Show real cisterns and elevated channels feeding controlled curtains of water along selected sections of wall, with visible collection troughs and drainage below; water is finite and comes from the cisterns, no floating magical water. Four grounded furnace houses with glowing mouths, chimneys and smoke, branching copper heat conduits serving workshops and outer approach slabs; no fire jets. Local protective boundaries span a few gate frames with small anchor seals and fine taut pale threads, subtle transparent shimmer only, not a giant force-field dome. Show prepared heavy hinged street barriers between neighborhoods, ordinary clear evacuation paths, neighborhood refuge houses receiving small groups of residents. Tiny mage-artisans in work clothes tending inscriptions on installations alongside non-magical crews, carts carrying supplies, believable medieval technology enhanced by collaborative magic. Strong material texture, exquisite composition, monumental grounded architecture, restrained magic, readable water and heat paths, atmospheric depth. No modern machinery, guns, electricity pylons, sci-fi, floating islands, cathedral spire overload or arbitrary rune text. This is a proposed visual interpretation, not a technical diagram.
